profile.name: Chinmaya Sri Rama Seshu Pasupuleti
profile.title: Data Engineer
profile.bio: Data Engineer with 4+ years of experience building enterprise data pipelines, cloud-based ETL/ELT workflows, data warehouses, and analytical data platforms. Hands-on experience with Python, SQL, AWS, Snowflake, Apache Spark, PySpark, Informatica PowerCenter/IICS, Oracle, Teradata, Airflow, and AutoSys. Experienced in data ingestion, batch processing, distributed data processing, data transformation, data quality, data reconciliation, data modeling, pipeline orchestration, production troubleshooting, and SQL optimization.
